<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/restart_grid"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Stops the Runtime and Archiver fleet, then replaces this process with
a fresh one via os.execv, so settings that only apply at startup take
effect without an operator having to restart the service by hand.

Runs on a short delay in a background thread so this response reaches
the client before the socket goes away. Stopping the Runtime can itself
take up to 30s (see PROC.runtime_supervisor.terminate's grace period),
so the new process may not be listening again for up to about that long.
